🏢 MI HB 6391 — New Rules Could Slow Down Data Center Construction in Michigan

Michigan is creating a new process for building large data centers. This bill, dubbed the "Data Center Siting and Community Protection Act," requires developers to get a ‘site certificate’ from each local government – county, city, or township – where they want to build. To get this certificate, companies must conduct detailed impact assessments, including studies of water, wetlands, farmland, and potential effects on local emergency services. ...
